# Bouquets and Bowties Charleston (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Wedding planning and event design for personalized, Southern-style weddings in Charleston, SC. Concept page, not their official site. Official site: https://bouquetsandbowtiescharleston.com

## Services
- Free wedding planning consultation
- Event design and planning
- Vendor coordination and recommendations
- Day-of coordination, setup and teardown

- Booking: now booking 2027 and 2028 weddings. Prices are not published.
